newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-JUVENTUS SQUEAK BY PART-TIMERS NOCERINA IN CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JUVENTUS SQUEAK BY PART-TIMERS NOCERINA IN CUP.

text.p: European champions Juventus needed an own goal by part-timers Nocerina on Wednesday to defeat the third division club 2-1 in a replay of their Italian Cup third round tie.

Serie C's bottom club, who earned the lucrative replay in Turin after drawing with Juventus 0-0 last month, looked set to pull off yet another upset after Franco Marchegiani sent a brilliant lob over goalkeeper Angelo Peruzzi in the 39th minute.

The tiny southern club had already defeated serie A clubs Piacenza and Perugia to reach the last 16 and the shock goal must have left supporters at the Delle Alpi stadium wondering if Juventus might suffer a similar fate.
But Juventus, whose absentees included Croatian striker Alen Boksic, quickly bounced back with a headed equaliser by tough Uruguayan defender Paolo Montero just before the interval.

A lucky bounce two minutes after the break turned out to be enough to clinch the tie for Juventus. A shot by midfielder Alessandro Del Piero bounced off Nocerina defender Giovanni Di Rocco and into the net.
Nocerina, who changed their coach last month, come from Nocera Inferiore, a run-down small town in the Naples hinterland. Juventus are third in serie A, two points behind leaders Inter Milan.
